title: Pho IN Vietnam- Phở Bưng Hàng Trống
caption:
THE BEST PHO IN VIETNAM- Phở bưng Hàng Trống
5 Steps to getting the BEST PHO i have ever had:
Step 1- find the alley from the google map location pin, walk down a narrow lane and follow the hand written sign that says “This way if you want pho”,
Step 2- take the narrow AF stairs up 
Step 3- walk into the family living room literally - the sofas are pushed aside, the tv is right there and you are literally in her living room!
Step 4- She doesn’t speak English but she communicates through the most basic method, since there is only one dish on the menu you literally show her the number of bowls you want with your fingers
Step 5- your bowl of pho & fried dough is placed on your table, take a taste, add chilli if you are like me and enjoy the experience which also includes stares from the locals wondering how you got there in the first place! 

Price: 40,000 VND (INR 140) per bowl
